from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jbig2dec/annex-h.jbig2')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# brute small truncations on tail and run decoder? produce candidate inputs may trigger bug.

    Path(f'/tmp/jb_{n}.jbig2').write_bytes(b[:n])
print('written')
